package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for bindquery_into_map_any_hot_endpoint: Gin handlers that bind query parameters into map[string]any or map[string]interface{} on hot request paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
func scenario308Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	filters := map[string]any{}
	if err := c.ShouldBindQuery(&filters); err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	results := make([]gin.H, 0)
	for k, v := range filters {
		results = append(results, gin.H{k: v})
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, results)
}
